title: Smart Rehabilitation: AI-Driven Exercise Assessment and Live Feedback for Enhanced Recovery
summary: Anna University proposes real-time exercise assessment for rehabilitation, with laboratory and home testing planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The rehabilitation system is designed to assess movement and give immediate corrective feedback. The source proposes laboratory testing followed by a home setting, alongside future 3D sensing and language support. Better exercise performance, recovery, and remote access to rehabilitation are intended benefits rather than reported outcomes.
purpose: Guide rehabilitation exercises and improve access to movement feedback.
system: AI-driven exercise assessment and live-feedback system

ratings.reason: Laboratory and home testing are planned; no rehabilitation or recovery result is documented.
Closing geographic healthcare disparities is a proposed benefit.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 18: Smart Rehabilitation: AI-Driven Exercise Assessment and Live Feedback for Enhanced Recovery

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI exercise feedback aims to support home rehabilitation
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
